sloka: विमानेषु प्रसुप्ताश्च दह्यमाना वराङ्गनाः।त्यक्ताभरणसर्वाङ्गा हा हेत्युच्चैर्विचुक्रुशुः ।। ६.७५.२३ ।।
transliteration: vimāneṣu prasuptāśca dahyamānā varāṅganāḥ।tyaktābharaṇasarvāṅgā hā hetyuccairvicukruśuḥ ।। 6.75.23 ।।

translations.english: The mansions burnt by fire fell down like a huge mountain struck by a thunderbolt.
